pages.text: Reiko's Economy Mod's job board has seven car jobs, which pay as you work:$(li)$(l)Driver$(): taxi rides, bus passengers, bus stops$(li)$(l)Mail Carrier$(): parcels$(li)$(l)Mechanic$(): repairs, tuning, tow-ins

$(li)$(l)Trucker$(): fuel delivered by tanker, and hauling a loaded trailer$(li)$(l)Garbage Collector$(): trash cans emptied$(li)$(l)Firefighter$(): fires put out$(li)$(l)Police Officer$(): unlicensed drivers ticketed
